text:
Devin: Heads-up — kicking off bring-up for Helios private VPC cluster in ap-southeast-2. Goal: air-gapped delivery, customer-managed transit, and a canary rollout. Need preflight checklist done by EOD Wed.
Priya: GPUs and sizing? is this for inference-only or mixed workloads?
Devin: Inference-heavy. Target config: 12x A10G, 48GB RAM each, 1x control plane (m5.xlarge equivalent). Option to swap to 4x A100 if they accept 2x cost.
Samir: Networking notes: customer will hand us a routed /22. Plan is BGP peer to their edge (ASN 65040). MTU 9000 across transit, VLAN IDs 120/121 for management and data. Confirmed no overlapping subnets.
Priya: Air-gap artifact plan? how do we get container images and model weights onto site?
Devin: Two-stage: 1) mirror images + checksum to an encrypted HDD, 2) ship via VendorShip to customer intake, 3) onsite operator runs local registry bootstrap. We'll use signed manifests.
Devin: Example checksum step to include in manifest:
```
sha256sum model-v1.tar.gz > model-v1.sha256
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -in model-v1.tar.gz -out model-v1.tar.gz.enc -pass file:./transfer.key
```
Samir: On the OS side, disable cloud-init network changes and set sysctl tweaks for inference nodes. Minimal sysctl snippet: 
```
echo 'vm.swappiness=1' >> /etc/sysctl.conf
echo 'net.core.default_qdisc=fq' >> /etc/sysctl.conf
sysctl -p
```
Samir: Also confirm NIC drivers for MTU 9000 and enable GSO/TCP segmentation offload.
Priya: BGP handshake items: remote-as 65040, local-as 65123, md5 password TBD, advertise only specific /24s. Add to INF-4312.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4312 for Helios bring-up: network + images + FW + KMS entries.
Katie: Cost snapshot: expected monthly run (12 A10G, reserved-ish mix) ~ $18k/mo infra + $2k/mo network egress estimates. If they opt A100 it's ~$36k/mo. Need to present 2 options in the PO.
Devin: Canary plan: route 10% of production traffic for 48h. Auto rollback if p95 latency > 600ms or error rate >1%. Metrics owner: Priya.
Priya: Acceptance test list (short):
- GPU smoke (run tiny model infer)
- End-to-end latency bench (local rps)
- KV cache persistence after node restart
- Model checksum/manifest validation
I'll own GPU smoke + KV test.
Samir: Validation command for GPU smoke (example): 
```
docker run --gpus all --rm helios/infer:canary \
  --model /models/model-v1 --input samples/hello.json
```
Dev: SRE/ops handoff items: runbook path /runbooks/helio/private-vpc-acceptance.md, admin user list, KMS key ARN, and signed AUP. Need customer sign-off on routing policy and maintenance windows.
Katie: Delivery logistics: VendorShip to pickup Wed 06:00 local, ETA site Thu 10:00. Need manifest, serial numbers, and decryption key in KMS (not on HDD). Customer will accept via signed receipt form.
Priya: Anything for certificates? we need to ensure cert chain is in local trust store and time sync via internal NTP — air-gapped NTP plan: use GPS/time appliance or pre-seeded time sync host.
ops-bot: Started job job-helio-seed: image-mirror -> manifest-verify -> seed-registry. Monitoring hook will post status updates to this thread.
Samir: Post-provision checks: GPU driver version, nvidia-smi smoke, container runtime cgroup v2, and node-exporter labels for zone/role.
Katie: SLA asks: they want 99.9% SLA and 4hr P1 response. That affects coverage ops staffing — flag to Sales.
Devin: Ok team — sync tomorrow 11:30 PT. @priya @samir @katie please add your preflight items into INF-4312 and drop any known blockers here.
Priya: Will add tests + NTP appliance note.
Samir: Adding MTU test script and driver verification steps.
Katie: I'll draft the cost options and PO language today.
ops-bot: INF-4312 updated with new subtasks (network-bgp, image-transfer, fw-list, acceptance-tests).
